comments.body: Orchestrator review of PR #340 (fixtures of dotfiles-T128-gate-evidence-a04, split under INV-2): 13 files under tests/fixtures/gate-evidence/ (twelve fixture records as JSON objects between --- lines, two pr-feedback JSON fixtures, .prettierrc with trailingComma none scoped to the directory), 164 added lines, no code. Each fixture matches a case of the a04 contract (stale head, S6 missing/present, finding quoting the grammar, wrong pr, duplicate key, NaN, dispatch key, ledger incomplete, badged review body; the review-body sweep fixture carries the unbadged and near-match bodies). Thread ids are JSON numbers; the gate on PR #329 compares ids as strings, so the audit of #329 checks the normalisation. CI 12 of 12 on the update-branch head, Codex review on 27e8a0ea "Didn't find any major issues", security review clean. Approved as data.
